headline: Frame-pacing percentiles and both memory ceilings pass with large margins (p95 9.0x, p99 6.9x, GPU memory 51x, working set 20x). The no-stall-above-50ms threshold FAILS in the high-speed and 30-minute scenarios. Both tail criteria are marginal: the three failing stalls measure 50.80, 50.20 and 50.50 ms against a 50 ms limit, and sustained growth passes at 0.93 MiB/min with R^2 0.45 against a proposed 1 MiB/min and R^2 0.5 rule. An earlier execution of the same matrix inverted both verdicts, so neither should be read as a stable result.

workspace.policy: Q-022 capture-workspace Option A (ADR-0023 operating addendum)
workspace.verification: The worktree was created fresh at the committed revision that contains the capture harness, and `git status --porcelain` was empty immediately before measuring. A checkout of that revision reproduces the measured executable. Every route package was rebuilt from checksum-locked fixture sources at the start of each run, so no stale generated output contributed to any measurement.
workspace.supersedes: An earlier execution measured from a worktree that necessarily carried the uncommitted harness, and was reported as non-conforming. Those artifacts were discarded and are not the evidence recorded here.

harness_corrections.defect: presented-frame time read from the smoothed engine delta
harness_corrections.impact: Godot smooths _Process(delta) against the 120 Hz physics step; p50/p95/p99 quantised to exactly 1/1080, 1/840 and 1/600 s and p95 was understated by about 23 percent (1.19 ms reported vs 1.54 ms actual).
harness_corrections.fix: measure from the Time.GetTicksUsec monotonic clock; both series recorded

harness_corrections.defect: unbounded per-frame sample lists made the harness distort the measurement
harness_corrections.impact: About 1.7M List<double> entries per series over 30 minutes (~55.6 MB), repeatedly reallocated onto the Large Object Heap; roughly 34 percent of the reported working-set growth and inflated stall counts belonged to the harness.
harness_corrections.fix: fixed-width histograms and pre-sized buffers with zero steady-state allocation; measured harness share of process allocation is 0.10 percent

harness_corrections.defect: measurement clock started before warm-up snapshot work
harness_corrections.impact: charged setup cost to the first measured frame as a spurious stall
harness_corrections.fix: clock starts after all warm-up completion work

measurement_method.vsync_note: V-Sync disabled and Engine.MaxFps unbounded are a measurement-method choice, not ratified policy, so presented-frame time can exceed the 119 Hz refresh interval and reveal headroom.

driver_state.driver_frame_limiter: none configured; an uncapped smoke run presented 977 FPS, which no frame limiter would permit

measurement_method.three_d_resolution_basis: GetVisibleRect reports the 2D content-scale reference, not the 3D render size. A same-binary scaling experiment confirms 3D follows the window: mean render GPU 0.2445 ms at 1280x720, 0.4106 ms at 2560x1440, 0.7916 ms at 3840x2160.
measurement_method.content: integrated visual slice: production Hero GT, production highway kit, balanced regional environment on the representative-corridor fixture
measurement_method.corridor_loop_note: The representative corridor is 24.665 km. Runs longer than one traversal enable the existing short-corridor loop, which teleports the vehicle to the route start. Loop wraps are timestamped and their frames are attributed separately from steady-driving stalls rather than discarded silently.

weather.reason: The build has no weather system. Grepping game/ for precipitation, wet-road, fog, or volumetric implementations returns nothing; the only related state is the EnvironmentVisualScenario 'Overcast' directional-light and ambient tint, which changes lighting colour only and is not weather. Simulating or substituting overcast lighting for a weather capture would misreport the scenario, so it is recorded as not captured.

threshold_failures.threshold: no steady-driving stall above 50 ms after warm-up
threshold_failures.measured: three stalls at 50.80 ms (high-speed, t=29.3 s, 91 m/s), 50.20 ms and 50.50 ms (30-minute run, t=686.1 s and t=1537.6 s, 40 m/s)
threshold_failures.attribution: Render CPU and GPU were both under 0.6 ms during every one of these frames, so essentially the whole stall is outside rendering. Maximum synchronous chunk build reached 41.9 ms and maximum environment build 40.5 ms in the same matrix, which is the right magnitude to explain them.
threshold_failures.marginality: All three exceed the limit by between 0.4 and 1.6 percent, and an earlier execution of the same matrix recorded zero steady-driving stalls. This threshold is a boundary case, not a stable failure.
threshold_failures.action_taken: reported; nothing was tuned, thinned, or relaxed to produce a pass

marginal_passes.threshold: no sustained positive growth over a 30-minute steady-state run
marginal_passes.observed: passed at 0.93 MiB/min with R^2 0.45, against a proposed rule of slope > 1 MiB/min AND R^2 >= 0.5. Both figures sit just under their bound, and an earlier execution of the same matrix failed this threshold at 1.87 MiB/min with R^2 0.79. The pass is a boundary case.

p95 and p99 pass with 9.0x and 6.9x headroom, but 81 percent of measured seconds still contain at least one frame above the 16.67 ms envelope. The distribution is bimodal: a sub-millisecond median with a recurring ~30 ms Gen0 GC spike roughly once per second.

garbage_collection_finding.conclusion: Gen0 collections track the recurring sub-threshold frame spike almost one to one across the 30-minute run. The spike is Gen0 GC driven by roughly 14.4 KB of allocation per rendered frame; the harness accounts for 0.10 percent of it.
garbage_collection_finding.upper_bound_caveat: Any profile that sets _smokeTest also runs Main.UpdateRunAutomationState every frame, marshalling about 35 values into a Godot Dictionary. That automation bookkeeping is counted in game_allocated_bytes, so the per-frame figure is an upper bound on real gameplay allocation.

build_configuration.why: Godot loads the assembly built for the running editor configuration, so a windowed capture driven through the editor binary measures a Debug build.
build_configuration.impact: Unoptimised IL and different JIT behaviour than a shipping export. Frame times, GPU attribution, and especially per-frame allocation are all affected. Budgets derived here should be re-derived against an exported Release build.

failures.note: All six captures in the final matrix completed on the first attempt. Two earlier full matrix executions were discarded after harness defects were found; see harness_corrections.
